gen-luckiest-guy-gf-aldrich: Aldrich reads like one thick thread traced across the page. Luckiest Guy shouts cheerfully above it with poured-looking ink, and that loud-meets-modern clash is the strongest thing about the pair.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-alexandria: Cheerful and loud, Luckiest Guy sits high and poured-looking, while Alexandria stays low with open c terminals beneath it. Round-tipped pen strokes up top, quiet restraint down below.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-anek-devanagari: Cheerful and loud, Luckiest Guy hits hard with ink that looks poured, free of calligraphic shading. And Anek Devanagari follows with open letter mouths and a large middle zone, so paragraphs should move along smoothly.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-anek-kannada: Luckiest Guy brings monoline cheer from stem to serif, loud and set high, over a body with squared-off woodblock height. Anek Kannada deserves a generous size so its far-stopping terminals show.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-anek-latin: Anek Latin holds its letters open, with lowercase that nearly reaches the capitals. Luckiest Guy is the loud one, crossbars matching its stems, and that cheerful gap is the pairing's best quality.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-anek-odia: Poured, uniform ink gives Luckiest Guy its loud, cheerful face. Anek Odia takes over below with unlatched rounds and capitals barely above the lowercase, and that quiet-versus-loud gap is the best thing here.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-anek-telugu: Wide bowls dominate the reading rhythm, rounds left open like an unlatched hook. Anek Telugu is made for that approachable reading, while Luckiest Guy exists to grab attention in loud, cheerful bursts.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-arimo: Arimo keeps spacious gaps in its rounded letters and a high mean line. Arimo does the quiet reading work, whereas Luckiest Guy, drawn like a laser-etched line, is the one built for noise.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-atkinson-hyperlegibl: Loud meets approachable: Luckiest Guy shouts in cheerful, uniform strokes. And Atkinson Hyperlegible, with clipped capitals and wide-set terminals on s, reads best at a modest size beside such a shouter.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-carrois-gothic: Luckiest Guy cuts a flat, stencil-like shape in single-weight strokes, cheerful and loud. Carrois Gothic follows with a high-set x-height and a generous opening in c, so a modest size is enough.
